title: GPT-6 Luna · Runway closure
description: Actual GPT-6 Luna decisions: a closure forces CFG101 to go around before the controller assigns runway 25C. The full 30-minute run completed, with three diversions and three separation-loss events.

title: GPT-6 Luna · Emergency landings
description: Actual GPT-6 Luna decisions during medical and low-fuel emergencies. This completed episode resolved all three emergencies with an average emergency wait of 8.7 minutes; seven separation-loss events also occurred.

title: GPT-6 Luna · Wind reversal
description: Actual GPT-6 Luna decisions as wind reverses the active runway direction from 25 to 07. DLH106 goes around and later touches down on 07C. The completed episode recorded nine separation-loss events and no collisions.

title: GLM 5.3 Flash · Runway closure
description: Actual GLM decisions during a surprise runway closure. This excerpt comes from the original run interrupted at 24 simulated minutes by an API rate limit; it is not a completed-episode score.

title: Runway closure & rerouting
description: An unexpected closure of runway 25R forces UAL102 to go around. The reference controller assigns another runway; the flight later touches down on 25L.
note: Reference controller demonstration; this clip does not show LLM decisions.

title: Emergency arrival & touchdown
description: DLH100 declares a medical emergency shortly after arrival. Follow the descent, landing clearance, and recorded touchdown on runway 25C.
note: Reference controller demonstration; this clip does not show LLM decisions.

title: Wind shift & approach changes
description: A reversal in wind changes the active runway direction from 25 to 07. Two approaches go around, then the reference controller starts new approaches from the other side.
note: Reference controller demonstration; this clip does not show LLM decisions.
